description_en: Fetches a valid OAuth authentication token
description_zh: 拉取一个有效的OAuth认证令牌
kebab_example: aliyun eiam-developerapi fetch-oauth-authentication-token --authorization Bearer_xxxxxx --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --credential-provider-identifier test_example_identifier --scope example:test_01_example:test_02 --region cn-hangzhou
name: FetchOAuthAuthenticationToken

parameters.help_en:
The authentication information. The format is \`Bearer ${access\_token}\`.

> Enter the access token issued by IDaaS
parameters.help_zh:
认证信息。 格式为：Bearer ${access_token}。

> 请输入 IDaaS 签发的 Access Token
parameters.name: authorization

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the credential provider
parameters.name: credential_provider_identifier

parameters.help_en:
The scope for the OAuth protocol.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the scope of the issued OAuth access token is determined by the scope configuration of the credential provider.

><notice>

Separate multiple scope values with spaces.

></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
对应OAuth协议的scope。

> 若不指定，则签发出的OAuth Access Token的scope范围为对应的凭据提供商处的Scope配置。

><notice>多个 Scope 值之间会通过空格分隔。></notice>
parameters.name: scope
